card.name: Marine and water-setting text, scattered words
card.fires_on: Scattered words inside sea, river, island or aquarium passages, such as 'of' or 'near' before a place, or the digit in a war-era date. Also partway through some drug names like lidocaine hydrochloride.

modes.label: Water and marine settings
modes.description: Linking words or word parts in text about oceans, rivers, islands, tanks and plankton.
modes.example: especially<< near>> the islands at Burswood.

modes.label: Partway through drug names
modes.description: Middle pieces of drug names such as hydrochloride or bupivacaine in label headings.

modes.label: Civil War river battle
modes.description: Digits and spaces in dates and island numbers in a river war narrative.

card.writes: It pushes toward words for land and ground (ground, airport, grassland, road) and away from water words (shore, swim, underwater).
card.plain: It fires on scattered words in water-related text and nudges the model toward land words rather than water words.
